μεθίημι: to let go, let loose, release
προστίθημι: to add, to apply, to close (a door); mid. to join (a group), take as an ally
προτίθημι: to place before, to propose, to prefer
συνεπιτίθημι: to help in putting on; mid. join in attacking
ἐπανατίθημι: to lay upon; entrust; shut again
ἐπιτίθημι: to lay, put on; (mid.) to attack
ἐφίημι: to send to; (mid) to long for
ὑπεκτίθεμαι: to bring one’s goods to a place of safety, carry safely away
ὑπερτίθημι: to communicate; mid. to surpass, to defer
